newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET--TRANSVAAL'S BACHER MAKES FOURTH CENTURY.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET--TRANSVAAL'S BACHER MAKES FOURTH CENTURY.

text.p: Transvaal opening batsman Adam Bacher compiled his fourth century of the season as his side's four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Northern Transvaal headed for a rain-affected draw at Centurion Park on Sunday
Bacher further advanced his claims for a return to the South African line-up in the second test against Australia with a patient innings of 102 after five and a half hours at the crease.

On a pitch better suited to the disciplined Northern Transvaal seam bowlers, Bacher struck seven fours and a six before being snapped up in the slips by Andre Seymore to give Fanie de Villiers his second wicket of the innings.
Shortly after Bacher's dismissal, captain Ken Rutherford declared the innings closed at 201 for six.
Northern Transvaal then reached 103 for three in their first innings reply before rain and bad light curtailed the third day's play in a rain-devastated match destined to end in a draw. Scoreboard:
